summary: The customer called to cancel their account due to unexpected monthly charges. The agent verified the account number, identified and waived the incorrect extra fees, successfully closed the account, and reassured the customer that no further balances were due. The call ended positively with the customer expressing satisfaction.

evidence.text: مرحبا سيدي، معك محمد من خدمة العملاء كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, professional, and respectful tone throughout the conversation.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، أنا فاهم عليّك تماماً، بس ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت عشان أشوف شو القصة؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and validated their feelings effectively.

evidence.text: أكيد سيدي، تم إغلاق الحساب بنجاح وما في أي مبالغ مترتبة عليك أبداً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent completely resolved the issue by waiving the erroneous fees and closing the account during the call.

evidence.text: تمام يا سيدي، شيكت على السيستم ولقيت إن في extra fees نزلت بالخطأ، وهلا عملت لها waive وفضيت الحساب نهائياً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained the steps taken clearly and concisely without using confusing jargon.

evidence.text: عافاك سيدي، وشكراً لاتصالك معنا، يوماً سعيداً!
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly closed the call with polite parting remarks and thanks.

evidence.text: تم إغلاق الحساب بنجاح وما في أي مبالغ مترتبة عليك أبداً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately reported the status of the account and the fee waiver based on the system check.

evidence.text: بس ممكن تعطيني الـ account number لو سمحت عشان أشوف شو القصة؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly requested the account number to verify and check the system before proceeding with account actions.
